steps.content: "The southwestern region is a barren wasteland, with nothing but bare mountains and dead trees."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: What lies beyond the wasteland?
"Mage Etti climbs up a giant, dead tree and gazes into the distance."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Huh? Uh... I don't see any giant trees around here...
Etti looks around. Her gaze finally lands on a streetlight by the outdoor activity area.
She squints at you, then leaps onto the streetlight with a whoosh.
...Ahem.
"Gazing into the distance, Mage Etti discovers a sizable settlement. Maybe if she finds a way to get there, she can gather some useful information."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But I don't have anything right now. It won't be easy to go there...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Then let me take a look around first.
You take out the dice, squat on the ground and gently roll it.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I knew it! Critical success!
"Mage Etti carefully observes her surroundings, and sees two women discussing something to her right. They are holding a bag of bread in their hands."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Ooh, bread!
Etti's eyes lit up, and she ran towards them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: A-aha... Old pal, what are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Looking for food.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh! You're looking for food! Well... that is a must-have for an adventure!
Standing at the foot of the enclosure, Hella patted Ninety-Nine on the shoulder three times as her eyes kept drifting to you.
"Mage Etti goes over to the women and gets a clearer picture of what they're doing."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Hello there! Are you two adventurers, too?
Etti's eyes dart back and forth between Hella and Ninety-Nine.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I heard you say just now that you're looking for food?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: This place looks completely barren. How can there be food here?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Um... I-I heard that a while ago, someone in a gray trench coat came and...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: ...Buried a bag of food here.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I was hungry so I dug it out.
As Ninety-Nine gesticulating, her gaze drifts towards you.
You give Ninety-Nine a secret thumbs up from behind Etti.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Ah... I see. Thank you for your honesty.
Etti chuckled, then turned to you.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I want to unleash a Magic Attack against them!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why are you attacking us right away?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're even more unreasonable than me!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Isn't it obvious?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I don't have much equipment on me, and no food either. Of course I have to collect some food for my adventure!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Grrr!!
Hella glares at Etti with pursed lips and a frown, as if she's on the verge of hitting her the next second.
You quickly walk between them and tug at the corners of their clothes.
Ahem. It's fine, it's fine. You can fight back, too.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: J-just you wait! I'll get Ninety-Nine to beat you to a pulp!
Hella squats down with a water pipe slung across her shoulder, looking like a street thug.
"According to the initiative calculation, Etti the Mage will attack first this round."
You cast the dice again, and after some rolling sounds, they froze on the number 10.
"Mage Etti attacks the adventurers she just met to steal their food. Her vicious and aggressive attack strikes one of them..."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Sorry, pal...
Before you could finish talking, Etti whips out her staff, leaps back, and bellows at the pair in front of her.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: "Ray of Frost!"
A gust of wind blew by. Etti is still in her posture, with Hella and Ninety-Nine staring back at her.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Eh... Game Master...
Ah! Oh oh!
You catch a glimpse of Etti's cold gaze and rush to continue casting the dice.
The dice roll to Etti's feet, showing a big 8.
"The Mage's spell hits... uh, Ninety-Nine the Barbarian. She suffers... let me count..."
"Mmm, our poor Ninety-Nine suffers five points of damage. Ninety-Nine, you're grounded for one round because of this spell."

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Because of this spell...
<size=30>Ninety-Nine, please just humor her.</size>

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Em... Ah.
Ninety-Nine steps back and sits on the ground. Seeing this, Hella leaps forward, swinging her water pipe and shouting wildly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: D-damn it! I'll avenge you!
"The petite Rogue stomps in fury, vowing to seek revenge against Etti."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Taste my steel pipe!!!
Hella grasps the water pipe with both hands and wields it in front of Etti's staff.
You squat down and gently cast the dice in front of Hella.
"Hella the Rogue attacks with a simple weapon—a water pipe."
"According to the points calculation, Etti the Mage suffers a total of... uh... 1 point of damage."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh?!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: What are you saying...
"Cough cough cough. After seeing how weak her attack was, Hella the Rogue starts venting in her native Rogue tongue. To everyone else, she sounds as inscrutable as Morse code."
"If you want to decode Hella's Rogue message, you must acquire skills like reading runes and score a critical success, or expend some luck..."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: No need. I'll give you two choices. You can keep fighting me... which I'm sure will lead to the total obliteration of these two in the next round.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Or... you can give me your food.
Etti puts away her staff and tilts her hat smugly, jiggling the dragon horns on it in triumph.
"Enraged by Mage Etti's provocations, Hella the Rogue rushes forward to defeat her at all costs."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? Oh oh oh... wahhhhhh!!!
Hella reacts, picking up her water pipe and rushes towards Etti.
"However, she misses when she swings her water pipe, and instead smacks Ninety-Nine's bag of bread onto the high wall."
Hearing her cue, Ninety-Nine looks up. After thinking for a moment, she tosses the brown cloth bag onto the barbed wall.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Game Master, aren't you cheating a bit too blatantly?
This is a logical plot twist. Anything is possible, right?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Grrrrrrr!
"With the world plunged in darkness, the trust and unity between people is gravely tested."
"Even someone who cannot fly can reach new heights with good company."
"Without food, not a single one of them can make it to the nearest town, let alone all three."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? So we're forced to take that bag of bread?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, that's way too many rules!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I guess it makes sense. We may not be able to survive without food.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: So... the bread is in danger right now, but we all need it.
Etti, Hella and Ninety-Nine approach the wall and look up at the bag of bread, each in their own thoughts.
"The three adventurers observe the fence. To their surprise, none of them are strong or skilled enough to safely remove the bag of bread from the wall's electric fence."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Huh?! I can't even get it from such a low wall?!
Etti looks at you in disbelief. You look down at your palm, which has notes scribbled all over it.
Seeing that you're ignoring her, Etti realizes this is another case of "the game master's rules." She snorts, ponders for a while, then goes over to Hella.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: So, want to work together?
Hella puts down the water pipe against the ground, and smiles.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Work together? That bread was ours to begin with!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But I defeated you, didn't I?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Besides, you two are a Rogue and a Barbarian. Without the help of a Mage, it'll be hard for you to survive even with the bread. Who will boost your attack and defense in battle? Who will treat you when you're injured?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmmm... Ninety-Nine really does need a healer when she fights.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: So, does that mean... deal?
Etti smiles and extends a hand to Hella.
Hella looks at Etti, her eyes darting around. She then clasps Etti with both hands.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sure! Then... we get a third of the treasures you find!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: What...?
"Etti the Mage and Hella the Rogue shake hands. The three happily agree to work together!"
As you speak, you push the three to the foot of the wall, as if to block Etti's next lines.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, dear friends, let's accept the guidance of fate and go explore the legendary castle!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Use my strength to the fullest!
Hella is still holding Etti's hand. Etti's body temperature had always been low, and now the hand being held by Hella is too hot for her to handle.
It's a long time before Etti finally lifts up her head again.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Sigh... all right. On the road to adventure, the more friends the merrier... Even if I have to share the treasures with you.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But since this is the case, y'all have to follow my orders on this adventure, okay? After all... I'm the strongest.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Mmkay! I'll take your word for it!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hmm...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Great! That's settled!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: So, for our next move...
Etti's eyes glimmer.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Hella! Ninety-nine! Go and smash that wall!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh oh oh! You mean to vandalize the Bu... I mean, the wall!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: That's fine with me.
"Even so, this wall is public property. There will be consequences if it gets damaged."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Don't worry. We'll run away as soon as we knock it down.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Got it. As long as we run fast, the consequences won't catch up to us!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Yes, exactly!
Etti and Hella rub their chins and look at each other, then give each other a high five.
...All right.
Ninety-Nine takes out her big sword and carries it on her shoulder. Red mist begins to appear around her arms—a sign that she's using her Sinner's power.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I'm ready.
"...The mighty Barbarian points her great sword at the troublesome wall, ready to attack with brute force."
The dice roll around everyone and ultimately stop before you.
"Um, Ninety-Nine the Barbarian attacks the wall with full force, but the wall's thickness and strength exceed everyone's expectations."
"After all, it's a wall designed to keep out adventurers, so it's incredibly tough. Not only does Ninety-Nine fail to smash it, but she also hurts her own head in the process."
L-let me try again...
You roll the dice cautiously under their gaze.
The dice come to a stop, revealing the number 8. You look away guiltily.
"The wall... the wall repels 5 damage points, on top of the 3 damage points received from the duel with Mage Etti..."
"Poor Ninety-Nine. Her blade bounces off the wall and strikes her body... Um... You died, Ninety-Nine."

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: But I'm still alive.
I mean in terms of HP.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-nine, you've got quite the bad luck...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...It's fine. Failing is part of the game. We have to get used to it.
The dice roll back to your feet. Your heart sinks as the number 15 shines before you.
"Ninety-Nine grips her sword and breathes deeply to gather her strength as red mist emanates from all over her body. Then, she roars and attacks the wall!"

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Roarrrrr!!!
As soon as you say this, Ninety-Nine hacks at the wall with her sword!
After a few thunderous cracks, a two-meter hole appears in the wall. The bread on the barbed wire also falls piteously into Etti's hands.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Awesome! Ninety-Nine, you're the best!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Critical success. Let's go.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: The glory is all yours, my friend!

Etti divides the bread among the three. They then hurtle through the hole one after another, clutching their shares of the bread between their teeth. You call out for them to slow down, but they completely ignore you.
"Ninety-Nine manages to smash a hole in the wall. Amidst all the smoke and dust, the team of adventurers successfully overcomes their first obstacle..."
As you say your lines, you quicken your pace so as not to lose them.
By the ruins of the wall, Nightingale and K.K. stare at each other while holding an iron chain in their hands. The smooth-edged stones under their feet had obviously been cut in advance.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I thought we agreed to smash a hole the size of Ninety-Nine?!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But... but this...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Ha, didn't you hear Ninety-Nine? Critical success!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Is this really okay...? I'm still worried that letting them get together to act like this... will lead to trouble.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Oh, don't worry. Chief has got it all under control.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Since that girl has childish delusions, we should use it to our advantage. I trust Chief.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Besides, he has a lot of experience by now from dealing with Bai Yi.
steps.female_content: Besides, she has a lot of experience by now from dealing with Bai Yi.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I guess. In any case, we have a lot of people on our side, so we should be able to handle it.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: All right, then. Continue onwards.
